description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named LeaveRequestCommentSearchFilterParams, which extends DateRangeSearchFilterParams. It is used to encapsulate filter parameters for searching leave request comments, including a leave request ID and sorting options.

classes.name: LeaveRequestCommentSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for filtering leave request comments with optional leave request ID and sort field.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter with default sort field.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestId
methods.description: Returns the leave request ID used as a filter criterion.

methods.name: setLeaveRequestId
methods.description: Sets the leave request ID for filtering.
